threats.title: Authentication
threats.description: There is no authentication in place for the requests from the browser

threats.title: Brute-force login attempts
threats.description: Attacker repeatedly guesses passwords for a known username until one succeeds.

mitigations.title: Multi-factor authentication
mitigations.description: Require a second factor (TOTP, hardware key, or SMS) for all user logins, especially admin accounts.

mitigations.title: Centralised audit logging
mitigations.description: Log all authentication events, privilege changes, and data access to a tamper-resistant centralised store.

mitigations.title: Enforce HTTPS everywhere
mitigations.description: Redirect all traffic to HTTPS and set HSTS headers to prevent downgrade .

threats.title: Expensive queries triggered by crafted input
threats.description: Attacker submits input that produces very slow database queries or regular expressions, tying up server resources.

mitigations.title: Input validation and output encoding
mitigations.description: Validate all input at the server side and encode output to prevent XSS. Use an allowlist approach where possible.

mitigations.title: Parameterised queries for all database access
mitigations.description: Use prepared statements or parameterised queries to prevent SQL injection. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings.
